title: Millionaire for Life Number Watch — Number 31 Has Gone Quiet for 43 Draws
headline: Number 31 Has Gone Quiet for 43 Draws

prose.intro: The Millionaire for Life board has a new record holder for silence. Number 31 has gone 43 straight drawings without an appearance.
prose.fact: Before this run, no gap in the 50-draw sample had stretched beyond 42 drawings. Number 31 just moved the ceiling to 43.
prose.context: The usual reminder applies, and it matters most on days like this: draws are independent. A streak, a gap or an odd shape says nothing about what the next drawing will do. We log these because they describe the data, not because they change it.
